Basic chat completion against real Anthropic API

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.usage())
```
